description: The plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of four different Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) configurations as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines identified in a legend. The "DPR w/o query" configuration is represented by a solid black line with no markers, which remains constant at a value of approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis. The "DPR w/ corpus expansion" configuration is shown as a solid red line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 35.15 at x=1, rises to 35.55 at x=2, and continues a gradual upward trend to reach a peak of roughly 35.79 at x=7, ending at approximately 35.78 at x=10. The "DPR w/ document expansion" configuration is depicted by a solid green line with upward-pointing triangular markers; it begins at approximately 34.78 at x=1, remains relatively steady with a slight peak of 34.93 at x=6, and ends at approximately 34.84 at x=10. Finally, the "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" configuration is represented by a solid blue line with star markers; it starts at approximately 34.75 at x=1, fluctuates to reach peaks of roughly 34.99 at x=2 and 34.98 at x=5, and then exhibits a general decline to end at its lowest point of approximately 34.37 at x=10.
